stories.title: Five men arrested near RAF Fairford released on bail as UK probes possible Iran or Russia link
stories.reason: Counter-terrorism detectives are examining whether the British nationals, all in their early twenties, acted as proxies for a foreign state or militant group, with Iran, Russia and non-state actors all under investigation after the men were released under strict bail conditions.

stories.title: Trump cancels $810 million in approved federal funding through a rare 'pocket rescission'
stories.reason: The move, timed to when Congress lacks time to review it before funds expire at fiscal year-end, hits refugee, education and housing programs across seven agencies and follows a Supreme Court ruling that upheld Trump's authority over a similar $4 billion foreign-aid rescission despite the GAO calling the tactic illegal.

stories.title: DHS announces a nationwide immigration enforcement 'surge' targeting sanctuary cities
stories.reason: The operation targets California, Illinois, New York, Oregon and eight other jurisdictions days after federal agents shot a Venezuelan delivery driver in Austin and released him from the hospital directly into ICE custody with the bullet still in his back.

stories.title: AI agent startup Instinct raises $1 billion at a $10 billion valuation, just a month after being valued at $2.5 billion
stories.reason: The Sequoia- and Benchmark-backed round for the personal-assistant agent, still in early access, ranks among the largest Series C deals ever in US enterprise software and shows how fast capital keeps chasing consumer AI agents after Meta's Muse breakout.

stories.title: Afghanistan says it killed 28 fighters who crossed from Pakistan; Islamabad denies any involvement
stories.reason: Kabul's defense ministry alleged Pakistani-backed militias including IS-affiliated fighters staged the incursion into Nuristan province, an accusation Islamabad called 'baseless,' deepening the fallout from Pakistani airstrikes inside Afghanistan just a week earlier.

stories.title: Hurricane Polo slams into Mexico's Baja California as a life-threatening Category 3 storm
stories.reason: With sustained winds near 115 mph, Polo is forecast to dump up to 12 inches of rain across Baja California Sur and Sonora, raising the risk of life-threatening flash floods and mudslides as it pushes inland toward the US Southwest.

stories.title: Nvidia's board approves the largest stock buyback increase in history, adding $150 billion
stories.reason: The move lifts Nvidia's total authorization to $235 billion through fiscal 2028, with Jensen Huang citing the company's cash generation from the 'once-in-a-generation' AI platform shift as justification for returning capital to shareholders at an unprecedented scale.

stories.title: Nasdaq falls as US-Iran tensions flare and oil holds near $106 a barrel
stories.reason: Stocks and bonds slid together as fading hopes for an imminent Hormuz breakthrough pushed oil back up, reviving inflation worries that could force the Fed to keep tightening even as the broader economy shows signs of strength.
